'''Foofice Lightingrunner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in the city of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Foofice Lightingrunner appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
